author: philly leader
title: Andressa Barbieri named NFL's Ultimate International Fan of the Year at 2026 Draft
text:
The Philadelphia Eagles announced on Apr. 29 that Andressa Barbieri, a fan from São Paulo, Brazil, has been named the NFL’s Ultimate International Fan of the Year at the 2026 Draft.
This recognition highlights the global reach and passionate following of the Eagles, who have extended their influence beyond Philadelphia to fans around the world. The team draws support through games, media, and merchandise according to the official website. Barbieri was previously honored as the Eagles’ International Fan of the Year before attending this year’s NFL Draft in Pittsburgh.
Barbieri described her reaction to being chosen for this honor: “It was unbelievable! I received an email saying they wanted to interview me about flag football and the Eagles, and I was already super excited about it. When they told me the real reason for the interview, I was in shock for a few seconds; I couldn’t say anything, just cry. I really didn’t believe it was possible; it was a wonderful surprise.” She said her connection with American football began in 2008 after noticing how distinctively enthusiastic Eagles fans were during games.
Reflecting on what it meant for her favorite team to play in Brazil and foster connections with Brazilian supporters through marketing rights, Barbieri said: “The Eagles having a connection with Brazil makes me even more passionate about the team. In Brazil, we greatly appreciate it when people from outside the country value our reality and our culture… it’s very gratifying to know that the Eagles care about Brazilian fans and want to be closer to us.” The team’s professional operations include providing football games as well as news coverage and fan engagement opportunities according to their official website.
Barbieri has been active in promoting flag football within Brazil by organizing championships, refereeing games alongside her husband André Pistarini—also an Eagles fan—and creating educational content for others interested in learning more about flag football rules. She described representing both Philadelphia and Brazil at this year’s draft as “a great honor and a great responsibility,” emphasizing how international fans find meaning by supporting their teams regardless of where they live.
The Philadelphia Eagles operate as a professional American football team based in Philadelphia since joining the National Football League in 1933 according to their official website. Their broad cultural impact is reflected not only locally but also among dedicated international followers like Barbieri.
